title: Mixed Event — Beyond The Dream of That Day — Episode7 Inheriting Hope

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! starts thinking about their next goal. During that time, they're offered a chance to appear on TV. Everyone is excited to hear the news, except Haruka, who doesn't quite share in their optimism...

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: And thanks for dancing with me, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: No, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I had so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great to hear!
Then, to cap things off...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Haruka!
Thank goodness! There you are!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Mommy, Daddy!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Ah, perfect timing!
That means you get to watch me perform my last song with your mommy and daddy!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
B-But...
I want to stay on stage with you...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm glad to see that you've fallen in love with performing on stage, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
So, moving forward...
Keep singing and dancing, and don't ever lose that smile of yours.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Moving forward...?

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Yeah. So, when you're all grown up and have learned how to spread hope to others by performing on stage like you did just now...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: I absolutely promise to be there to see you!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Father
rows.Line: Come here, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
Bye bye, miss.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Father
rows.Line:
We don't know what to say.
Thank you so much for looking after our daughter... And letting her perform on stage with you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
We really appreciate what you did.
Haruka, what do we say to the nice lady...?

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure.
This is actually a pretty normal occurrence.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Father
rows.Line: Normal...?

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
Mommy, Daddy...
You need to look at the stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
She's really amazing.
She can make so many people smile just by singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: She's like the princess from my book...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Father
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, she does seem like a wonderful person. I mean, she was able to put such a big smile on your face...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: She said that it's an idol's duty to spread hope to others and make them smile...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: So... So, I...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I think she's so amazing. And I want to be just like her...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I want to spread hope to others the way she does... I want to make lots and lots of people smile...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I want to become an idol too...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Haruka... You want to become an idol?

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Do you think I can...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Father
rows.Line: Yes, I think you can.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes.
Because your smile, Haruka... It's the cutest in the world!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
So, someday...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: I'm gonna become an idol just like her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That really takes me back.
I can still recall exactly what happened that day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Her frilly outfit was so cute, and it fluttered every time she moved...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Her smile glimmered as she sang and danced too. It's like she was lighting a fire inside my heart as she did...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't realize it until then, but that was me being filled with “hope”.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What I want to spread to everyone is the hope I felt that day. The belief that tomorrow will be a better day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's not going to change.
Not now. Not ever...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Are you still up?
There's something I'd like to show you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? What do you want to show me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. This.
Your father just happened to spot it in the evening paper.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The evening paper?
Oh, did they write an article about our solo show...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, a paper with nationwide reach couldn't have...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Here, look.
It's a very brief article...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: But isn't this that lady you like so much, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: L-Lemme see that...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Her clothes and hair are different now, but that smile... It has to be...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Although she's retired from being an idol and stepped away from the spotlight, she continues to spread hope to others...”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Now, following her retirement, she's become a radio personality for a station in another part of the country. However, her activities are not confined to a cramped studio.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Between retirement homes, kindergartens, hot springs and such, she uses her past experience as a star to stand on stages all over her region...”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “And so, she continues to spread hope and inspire courage in others with her dazzling smile and beautiful voice.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what happened to her after she retired from being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But that's so great...
She hasn't changed... She's still spreading hope to lots and lots of people.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, look at this photo...
She's smiling alongside all these children. She hasn't changed one bit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
She really hasn't.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for showing me this, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was able to receive more hope from her because of this article...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This article...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
Because of this article... Now, I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Haruka?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I finally found the answer I was looking for. I need to tell the others about this tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She gave me another push...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Even now...
You're still my hero.
